messages.text:
I've created a new refund proposal for the brass floor lamp. The refund is 48.90 BRL (refund-policy/v2/amount).

- **Why the earlier proposal expired:** Proposal h469-p1 lapsed before it was paid. A proposal is only valid for 72 hours after it is created, so you need a new one (refund-policy/v2/validity).
- **Voucher payment:** A refund is paid automatically only when the order has exactly one valid payment record, and it goes only to that payment (refund-policy/v2/payment). The shop's records show one valid payment on this order. I can't see from here whether it was a voucher.

Please confirm the proposal with the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't count. After you confirm, a staff member reviews the request (refund-policy/v2/approval). The proposal stays valid for 72 hours (refund-policy/v2/validity).
